topic: some people are only for a season
lines: Some people come into your life for a *season.*
To teach you something. To help you *through* something.
It doesn't mean you did something *wrong.*
#Holding on to people who stopped growing with you will keep you *small.*
You'll stay quiet so they stay *comfortable.*
And slowly, you'll forget who you were *becoming.*
You'll feel the distance long before you *admit* it.
The conversations get *shorter.* The support gets quieter.
Be grateful for what they *gave* you.
Then make room for the people who *match* where you're going.
The ones who clap when you *win.*
end: Send this to someone who needed to hear it.

post.caption: Some people are seasons. Let them go with love. 🌅
